mechanism: Both drugs are CYP3A4 substrates and dronedarone is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor, increasing ranolazine levels and QT prolongation risk; additive cardiac effects on conduction and repolarization.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval; consider ranolazine dose reduction if coadministration necessary; monitor for increased ranolazine adverse effects (dizziness, nausea).
